text: Thirty years after her adoption, Laura returns to the closed orphanage where she grew up, with her husband Carlos and their adopted son Simón, planning to reopen it for disabled children. Simón speaks of a new friend named Tomás and draws him as [a boy in a sack mask|images|dolls, masks and likenesses]. After a quarrel at the opening party, [Simón disappears|trigger|someone goes missing], and months of searching lead Laura to a medium, to [the fate of the orphans she once knew|wrong|harm done to children], and to [an old children's game|rules|the dead do not rest] played again in the empty house.
